rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: The Senate's filed copy of a Mandado de Notificação addressed to 'MICHEL TEMER, Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil', dated 'Senado Federal, em 12 de maio de 2016' and signed by Senator Renan Calheiros as President of the Senate, informs him that, the Chamber having authorized the process and the Senate having admitted it at its extraordinary session of 11 May 2016, President Dilma Vana Rousseff was intimated of Denúncia nº 1 of 2016; that from her receipt of the intimation the impeachment process is instituted and she is suspended from her functions under art. 86, § 1, II of the Constitution until the judgment ends or the 180-day period elapses; and that he is therefore to assume the Presidency immediately and on an interim basis ('assumir imediata e interinamente a Presidência da República') under art. 79.

locator.item: addressee block; paragraphs 1-2; dateline and signatures

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: A Termo de Juntada dated Brasília, 12 May 2016, signed by Luiz Fernando Bandeira de Mello Filho as clerk (Escrivão) of Denúncia nº 1 of 2016, certifies that on that date he filed in the case, with the documents of the President's intimation and summons, a 'Cópia do Mandado de Notificação expedido para o Sr. Vice-Presidente da República, Michel Temer, assinado por S.Exa. no anverso'.

locator.item: Termo de Juntada, item 5; dateline and signature
